name: x-profile-photo
description: X profile photo, 400x400 square (X recommends 400x400, max 2 MB, JPG/PNG/GIF, no animation; it is shown as a circle, about 40 px in the timeline). Keep the mark inside the inner circle; a ring keeps the edge visible on the white, dim-navy and black themes. Brand-neutral placeholder: swap the initials for the project's supplied logo or the YouTube profile mark as an image layer (fit contain).
